title: Kissed Molten French Udon Noodles
description: Rich and molten French dish featuring udon noodles, lacquer glaze, and ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients, served in a lotus leaf wrap.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the udon noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small saucepan, heat the lacquer glaze over low heat until it is warm and syrupy.
In a large skillet, heat the truffle oil over medium heat and saute the garlic and shallots until they are softened.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they are tender and lightly browned.
To assemble the dish, place a portion of the cooked noodles on a lotus leaf, followed by a spoonful of the mushroom mixture and a drizzle of the lacquer glaze.
Sprinkle the top of each portion with grated gruyere cheese.
Serve the noodles immediately, garnished with additional lotus leaves if desired.
Let the noodles rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
